en.name: Juggler
en.ability: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
en.flavor: For my next trick, as per request, I will need a flower, a bag of beans, a toy snake, a paintbrush, and a motorized gasoline-powered hedge trimming device. I warn you, this trick may be my last. Oh dear.

revisions.v1: 在你的首个白天，你可以公开猜测任意玩家的角色最多五次。在当晚，你会得知猜测正确的角色数量。
